cases.name: the board over the real API: the connected author, the task link, the bounded read, and the read cursors
cases.vector: noded --agents <builder + librarian>: the empty board; a post for an unconnected CID is the register's own 409, verbatim; a post naming a task the ledger does not hold is a 400; the subject/body caps; a connected agent's post is p1 with the author's own role and the driver's name; POST /board/read drops the unread count to zero and the board's own unread line agrees; a cursor behind the agent's own is refused 409 naming the cursor (a cursor never rolls back); a replay is idempotent; a cursor past the newest post is refused 409; and the response is bounded (257 posts -> the 256 newest, truncated said so)

cases.name: the conversations: a delivered say read back byte-exact from the peer's own log, an undeliverable say recorded with the hub's reason, and the pair's thread
cases.vector: a 2-role fleet (builder + librarian) on the suite's own vsockd --admin-port --roles and noded --hub-admin --workspace: a say is delivered through the hub and the peer's own /workspace/messages.log reads back byte-exact through /tell (the builder's, with read_file); the other direction is delivered too — the channel is the plaza's basis, not a role's privilege, and the hub's policy is proven live by a 403 on a tool the librarian does not grant; a stopped session makes the peer undeliverable and the row records delivered:false with the hub's own words; the self-say and text caps; and the pair thread with the ACTIVE_SECS window

notes: the ACTIVE_SECS *decay* (a pair whose last exchange is older than the 120 s window) is NOT exercised here: nothing in the API lets a caller age an exchange and a case that slept 120 s would slow every run for a rule the store already pins. What this case asserts is what a caller can observe: the window is the exported ACTIVE_SECS (120) in every view that reports activity (so no client hard-codes it), a fresh pair is active with its count and last_at, a never-spoken pair is an empty, inactive thread, and an undelivered exchange still counts as activity. The boundary itself (inclusive) is covered by crates/noded/src/social.rs's own tests (is_active / pairs_of).
